Start your research degree at UTS
Join a community of researchers tackling real-world challenges in health, climate, technology, business and society. Explore research opportunities, connect with experts and take the next step towards a research degree at UTS.
Ready to apply?
Why research at UTS?
explore
Be guided by experts
Become world-ready, from wherever you are in the world.
workspace_premium
Use world-class facilities
Build your research community, develop a professional network and access world-class facilities.
book_ribbon
Create global impact
Contribute to research that influences policy, advances industry and addresses challenges facing communities around the world.
crowdsource
Access diverse funding opportunities
In addition to UTS scholarships, you can work with us to find a range of sponsored support pathways.
Find your research pathway
UTS offers different PhD pathways depending on your goals, research interests and preferred way of working.
